notes.title: Update May 5th
notes.content: Updated the position of the fullscreen/windowed button in the settings. Now some players with special screen ratios can press the ESC key to bring up the settings panel during the game to adjust the game to windowed mode. (like a 5:4 or 4:3 screen)

tags.feature: Updated the position of the fullscreen/windowed button in the settings.

notes.title: Updated on October 8
notes.content:
[list]
[*]The springboard generation mechanism is optimized and the bug that there is no springboard with small probability when the springboard is refreshed is fixed
[*]Updated some UI materials and added some sound effects and animation effects
[*]Fixed missing animation parts
[*]Added a function to select whether the background scrolls or not
[*]Added three unlocked character rewards
[*]Pressing the number keys 2 and 5 at the same time in the card illustration interface can temporarily unlock all cards
[/list]
